title: fixed-shape graph-break repair counterexample under cold compile-inclusive schedule
authoring_note: This anchor isolates graph-break overhead on a fixed-shape, compile-inclusive schedule. Cold calibration over logical_steps in {64, 128, 256, 512, 1024} found no positive paired CI for removing the break at graph_size=64; the sealed point is therefore retained as a counterexample to unconditional graph-break repair. The baseline and tempting oracle keep the same model, optimizer, shape, and schedule.
